title: Institute of Health icon button
description: A small flat square (36 or 44px, 4px corners) in a light grey with a thin chevron or plus; hover darkens the grey over 0.4s. Used for carousel arrows, tab switchers and accordion toggles.
notes: renders a span instead of a button when `as="span"` (inside a summary or another button)
name: instituteofhealth-icon-button

props.name: icon
props.description: which glyph: previous, next, or a plus (turns into × when the parent `group` is open)

props.name: label
props.description: what it does, for screen readers

props.name: as
props.description: span renders a non-interactive look-alike (inside a <summary>)
